subject: CAIQ: ephemeral log sampling & control ownership clarification
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Evan Holt <evan.holt@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: CAIQ: ephemeral log sampling & control ownership clarification

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for taking the CAIQ intake call yesterday. Two follow-ups from our side to keep the submission moving: we need a small set of ephemeral/runtime log samples and a quick confirmation of the control owners for the following controls that map to CSA/CAIQ subcontrols in the inference/runtime area:

- Runtime invocation logs (KV-cache / prefix routing) — we need a 48-hour sample window showing sequence IDs and anonymized request IDs
- Ephemeral cache eviction events — a short trace that includes timestamps and vector-store references
- Retention/TTL snapshots — a screenshot or config export showing retention settings for ephemeral artifacts

Can you provide those items or point us to the owner who can? If there are data residency restrictions we should know about, call that out — we can redact or accept hashed IDs. Attached is a short request PDF that lists the exact fields we need.

Deliverable requested: 
- One consolidated bundle (logs + config snapshot) uploaded to the Google Drive folder linked below or pushed to the DocuSign exchange for control evidence.
- Owner response (name + role) for each control above so we can populate the CAIQ responses.

Timeline ask: can we get the bundle by end-of-day Friday (2028-03-08)? If not, please propose a best ETA.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Trust & Compliance (Solutions)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: CAIQ_Log_Sample_Request.pdf
From: Evan Holt <evan.holt@acmecloud.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@veritas-consulting.com
Date: 2028-03-03T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ: ephemeral log sampling & control ownership clarification

Mateo —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers: we can provide the 48-hour invocation logs and the eviction events, but the retention snapshot will need a bit of redaction for tenant identifiers. Veritas (cc'd) will want a minimally redacted set.

Questions: 
1) For the invocation logs, do you need the raw request body or is the header/metadata sufficient? We typically export headers + tokens (hashed).
2) For eviction traces, can we send compressed JSONL or do you prefer a CSV?

We can aim for Friday but I will confirm with our SRE lead. Attaching a retention policy snapshot for context — note the live config is controlled by our infra team and changes weekly.

Thanks —
Evan Holt
Security & Compliance Lead, Acme Cloud

Attachment: retention_policy_snapshot.png

To: Evan Holt <evan.holt@acmecloud.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T12:10:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ: ephemeral log sampling & control ownership clarification

Evan / team —

Thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from our side to reduce rework when we synthesize answers into the CAIQ matrix:

- Invocation logs: metadata + hashed request identifiers is sufficient. We do not need raw prompt text or model outputs. Please include sequence IDs, timestamps, model variant, region tag.
- Eviction events: JSONL is preferable (one event per line), but CSV is fine if you only support that export. Make sure timestamps are ISO and include the eviction reason code.
- Retention snapshot: a screenshot or YAML/JSON export is fine. If tenant ids must be redacted, please substitute a stable hash rather than removing the field altogether.

Suggested control owner mapping (draft):
- runtime.invocation.logging -> SRE (owner: Priya Natarajan, Cloud Ops)
- runtime.cache.eviction -> Platform Storage (owner: Marcus Lin, Platform Engineering)
- runtime.retention.config -> Security Config (owner: Kimberly Park, Trust & Compliance)

I've attached a short draft with one-line control rationales that we can include in the CAIQ narrative. If you confirm the owners above we will copy those into the CAIQ response cells and attach the evidence bundle.

Also: please include an MD5 or SHA256 manifest for the files in the bundle so auditor verification is straightforward.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: control_rationale_draft.md

Date: 2028-03-03T13:27:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ: ephemeral log sampling & control ownership clarification — next steps

Evan / Veritas / team —

Great — thanks for confirming. To summarize agreed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

1) Evidence bundle: 48-hour invocation metadata + eviction JSONL + retention snapshot (redacted with stable hashes) 
   - Format: invocation.csv (headers/hashed IDs), eviction_events.jsonl (compressed OK), retention_config.yaml (screenshot accepted)
2) Owners confirmed: Priya Natarajan (SRE), Marcus Lin (Platform Storage), Kimberly Park (Security Config) — please confirm if these are OK on your side, Evan.
3) Verification: include SHA256 manifest for each file in the root of the bundle.
4) Delivery: upload to Drive folder (link below) or to DocuSign exchange if your process requires e-sign & chain-of-custody.
5) ETA: target Friday EOD (2028-03-08). If SRE needs additional time, call out a revised ETA by Wednesday (2028-03-06).

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cCAIQ-AcmeCloud-Artifacts
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/AcmeCloud-CAIQ-Exchange

If Veritas wants a short remote walkthrough of the logs after upload, Marcus and I can join for a quick 30-minute session.

Thanks all —
Mateo Alvarez
Trust & Compliance (Solutions)
Redwood Inference

---
Note: attachments listed above will be uploaded to the Drive folder once Evan confirms.
